messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — High 5xx spike observed in eu-west during the green swap. Service: route-proxy. Error type: 502 gateway. Approx 28% of requests failing for ~3m. Auto-runbooks triggered.

sam: saw it too, just after the DNS flip. graphs show green instances returning most errors, blue looks fine. tagging oncall.

anya: oncall here. I'm looking at request traces now. Initial suspicion: connection resets between gateway and model-serving pool (green).

leo: digging into LB logs — backend health probes for green are flapping with TLS handshake failures. Not seeing config change on the instances themselves.

maria: confirm customer impact? Are production customer sessions failing or is it internal traffic only?

jordan: from SLO dashboard: ~12% of active users saw degraded responses (in eu-west). External p99 latency spiked + lots of 502 for text-generation routes. Some customers reported timeouts.

sam: repeating the quick checks: `curl -I https://api.eu.redwood.ai/health` shows `502` intermittently. `dig api.eu.redwood.ai` returns expected A records spread across blue/green IPs. TTL is 20s.

devops-bot: Canary deploy job 83721 completed 02:12:11 UTC. Traffic shift command executed: `trafficctl shift --deploy region-eu-green --percent 50`.

anya: I want to stop the rollout and put green out of rotation. Trying feature-flag kill-switch for the region first to avoid a full rollback. Executing: `flagsctl set region-eu.use_new_pool false --author=anya`

sam: flag applied. Confirming traffic controller...

devops-bot: Flag change observed. Traffic controller rerouting in progress.

leo: metrics look like traffic is moving back to blue but not fully — some clients still hit green IPs (possibly DNS cache). We should also remove green from LB to avoid 502s while DNS propagates.

maria: on it — removing green backends from autoscaling group. Running `asgctl remove-instances --group region-eu-green --all` (dry-run then apply).

jordan: customer-facing error rate decreasing to ~6% now. Good sign.

sam: issuing rollback command to undo the deploy for safety:
```
deploymentctl rollback --deployment region-eu-green --to-version 2026-03-10T02:00Z
```
Applying now.

devops-bot: Rollback started. Job 83725 queued. ETA ~45s.

leo: also seeing sporadic DNS TTL caching on some edge caches. Suggest we issue a temporary global traffic rule to prefer blue for eu region while caches flush.

anya: creating a short-lived edge rule: `edgectl set-prefer --region eu --target blue --duration 10m`

devops-bot: Edge rule applied.

sam: monitoring traces — 502s dropping to baseline. Rolling window errors back to normal in eu-west.

maria: rollback job finished, green instances removed from rotation. Health checks are green for blue.

jordan: reached out to two affected customers proactively (account teams notified). They acknowledged and are fine with our rollback.

leo: handing off to next oncall (sam is ending shift). @sam can you summarize for handoff and add follow-ups?

sam: summary for handoff: partial eu green rollout caused TLS handshake failures between gateway and green pool (exact root cause TBD). Mitigation steps: 1) Feature-flag kill-switch to force blue preference, 2) removed green from LB, 3) rolled back deployment, 4) applied edge prefer-blue rule to accelerate global convergence, 5) notified customers. Current status: resolved, error rates back to baseline.

anya: opened short lived incident channel and added runbook notes. Filing postmortem ticket: PM-INC-2026-042.

devops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV3. Escalation timer cleared.

maria: follow-ups: a) collect TLS handshake logs from green instances, b) validate certificate rotation/chain on green pool, c) reproduce in staging with same deploy job, d) add a synthetic test for LB probe TLS.

leo: I'll own (a) and (b). @anya take (c). @sam add the synthetic probe item to the infra backlog and tag eng-runtime.

sam: ack. handing over to leo for overnight, I'm off in 10. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident closed (2376543210). Remember to attach customer impact notes and link the postmortem to the incident ticket.

maria: will schedule a quick triage sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC to go over logs and RCA draft.

leo: logging a short note: observed `TLS alert 40` in handshake logs on green nodes starting at 02:12:08 UTC.

anya: adding that to the PM-INC ticket.

sam: good job team.
